source.section: Table 1-1 ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 Series Comparison; Section 1.1 Features

notes: Same module datasheet as esp32-s3-wroom-1-n8.json -- see that profile's note for why this module-level flash figure is real and non-null where the bare-die profile's isn't. This SKU ('-N16R8') carries 16 MB Quad SPI flash plus 8 MB Octal SPI PSRAM per Table 1-1; total_flash_bytes reflects only the Quad SPI flash figure (16 MB), since PSRAM is a distinct external RAM resource, not flash, and this project doesn't currently have a field for it. total_sram_bytes (512 KB on-chip) is unchanged from esp32-s3.json -- same die, confirmed identically in this datasheet's own feature list. dev_kit_aliases is deliberately empty for the same unconfirmed-SKU-mapping reason as esp32-s3-wroom-1-n8.json.
